content: Řebni n Zzawect Tameqqrant

Deg useggʷas wiss arebɛa-mya u-tmanyin awarni i uffuɣ n ayt n Israil zi temmurt n Miṣra, deg useggʷas wiss arebɛa n tgelda n Suliman x Israil, deg uyur n Ziw, ayur wiss tnayen, imsar, aqa netta ibda ad ibna Taddart n SIDI. *
Taddart i ibna ujeǧid Suliman i SIDI tuɣa-tt settin n iɣaǧen n tuzzeggart u ɛicrin n iɣaǧen n tiru u třatin n iɣaǧen n řuɛřa.
Asqif n wadaf ɣar zzat n Wexxam n Zzawect Tameqqrant n Taddart, tuɣa-t ɛicrin n iɣaǧen n tezzuggart ɣar wudem n tiru n Taddart, u tiru nnes tuɣa-t ɛecra n iɣaǧen ɣar wudem n Taddart.
Netta igga i Taddart tiburjatin, bellɛen tent s tewwura ak-d iɛumad i ubelleɛ.

Ɣar řḥiḍ, ɣar marra iɣezdisen nnes n Taddart, ibna ijj n řebni n zziyada, ɣar řeḥyuḍ i d as dd-innḍen i Taddart, řeḥyuḍ n Wexxam n Zzawect Tameqqrant u n Wexxam n Daxeř n Zzawect. Igga řebniyyat n řeḍruf am wafriwen ɣar iɣezdisen n Taddart deg wenneḍ.

Tisefři n wadday tuɣa-tt di xemsa n iɣaǧen n tiru u tenni di řwesṭ tuɣa-tt di setta n iɣaǧen u tenni wiss třata tuɣa-tt di sebɛa n iɣaǧen, maɣar igga tinebdatin ɣar barra n Taddart ɣar iɣezdisen nnes, ḥima tisefřin war ttidfent ca di řeḥyuḍ n Taddart.
Umi tᵉttwabna Taddart, aqa tᵉttwabna s tṣuḍar ittwaqessen zi mani tent neqcen, ařami war ttwisřen ifḍisen, niɣ ccaqur niɣ ca zi řeqcuɛ n wuzzař di Taddart řami tᵉttwabna.
Tawwart i řebni n řeḍruf ɣar umerwasu tuɣa-tt ɣar uɣezdis afusi ař zzat n Taddart. X ddrujat yennḍen ttgeɛɛaden ɣar wenni deg umerwasu u zeg umerwasu ɣar wenni wiss třata.
Ammu i ibna Taddart, ikemmeř i-tt. Issduriy Taddart s tḥenya u s teřwiḥin n ukeccuḍ n tneglin.
Ibna ɛawed řebni n zziyada ɣar marra Taddart, xemsa n iɣaǧen n řuɛřa i kuř ṭṭebqet Wanita yarsa s tḥenya n ukeccuḍ n tcejjart n tengelt x Taddart.
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Suliman, inna:
“X Taddart-a i tbennid: Mařa cek tuyured ɛlaḥṣab tiweṣṣa inu u ad tegged lfarayiḍ inu u ad teḥḍid řumurat inu umi daysent tuyured, xenni Necc ad ac ssqefřeɣ awař i ssiwřeɣ ɣar babac Dawud.
Necc ad zedɣeɣ di řwesṭ n ayt n Israil u Necc war semmḥeɣ ca di řgens inu Israil.”
Suliman ibna Taddart u ikemmeř i-tt.

Netta ibna uřa d admawen n řeḥyuḍ n Taddart nni iǧan ɣar daxeř s tfeřwin n ukeccuḍ n tcejjart n tengelt. Zi tisi n Taddart ař řeḥyuḍ n tzeqqa iřeḥḥef i-ten s ukeccuḍ u iřeḥḥef i tisi n Taddart s ukeccuḍ n tcejjart n umerzi.

Tuɣa ibna ɛad ɛicrin n iɣaǧen ktar zeg iɣezdisen n ḍeffar n Taddart s tfeřwin n ukeccuḍ n tcejjart n tengelt, zi tisi ař tazeqqa n řeḥyuḍ, uca igga ttasiɛ di daxeř nnes d Axxam n Daxeř n Zzawect i Netta, d Aqdas x Uqeddas.
Taddart tuɣa-tt arebɛin iɣaǧen n tuzzeggart, ixs ad yini Axxam n Zzawect Tameqqrant nni ɣar zzat.
Tuɣa akeccuḍ n tcejjart n tengelt i iǧan ɣar daxeř n Taddart ittwaneqqec s tɛebbuzin d nnuwwarat ggur ad arezment. Marra tuɣa akeccuḍ n tengelt, war dd-ittbin uřa d ijj weẓru.
Igga Axxam n Daxeř n Zzawect ɣar daxeř qaɛ n Taddart, ḥima ad din issars Ttabut n Řɛahd n SIDI.

Axxam n Daxeř n Zzawect tuɣa-t ɛicrin n iɣaǧen n tuzzeggart ɣar uɣezdis n zzat u ɛicrin n iɣaǧen n tiru d ɛicrin n iɣaǧen n řuɛřa. Iřeḥḥef i-t s wureɣ izedgen. Iřeḥḥef ɛawed aɛalṭar s ukeccuḍ n tcejjart n tengelt.
Suliman iɣeǧef daxeř n Taddart s wureɣ izedgen. Ɣar zzat n Wexxam n Daxeř n Zzawect isseɛdu ssnaseř n wureɣ. Iɣeǧef Wexxam n Daxeř s wureɣ.
Iɣeǧef marra Taddart s wureɣ, ařami tkemmeř marra Taddart. Iɣeǧef marra aɛalṭar nni iǧan ɣar Wexxam n Daxeř n Zzawect s wureɣ.
Deg Wexxam n Daxeř n Zzawect igga tnayen n ikiruben n ukeccuḍ n uzemmur. Tiddi nsen tuɣa-tt di ɛecra n iɣaǧen.
Ijj n wafriw n ukirub tuɣa dayes xemsa n iɣaǧen u deg wafriw nneɣni n ukirub tuɣa dayes ɛawed xemsa n iɣaǧen. Zeg ixef n yijj n wafriw nnes ař ixef n wafriw nnes nneɣni aqa ɛecra n iɣaǧen.
Akirub nneɣni tuɣa ɣares ɛawed řeɛbar n ɛecra n iɣaǧen. Ikiruben tuɣa ɣarsen s tnayen idsen ijj n řeɛbar d ijj n waddud.
Ijj n ukirub tuɣa řuɛřa nnes ɛecra n iɣaǧen u ammu uřa d řuɛřa n ukirub nneɣni.

Netta issbedd ikiruben di řwesṭ n taddart n daxeř. Ifriwen n ikiruben tuɣa bezzɛen ařami afriw n ijj ittakkʷaḍ ijj n řḥiḍ u afriw n ukirub nneɣni ittakkwaḍ řḥiḍ nneɣni. Ɣar řwesṭ n taddart mmḥadan ifriwen nsen ayawya, afriw ɣar wefriw.
Netta iɣeǧef ikiruben s wureɣ.
Marra řeḥyuḍ n Taddart ɣar marra iɣezdisen nnes inqec i-ten s uqessi n ineqqicen n ikiruben d tcejjura n tini d nnuwwarat yarezmen, zi daxeř u ɣar barra.
Iɣeǧef tisi n Taddart s wureɣ am deg wexxam n ḍaxeř am deg wexxam n zzat.
Ɣar wadaf n Wexxam n Daxeř n Zzawect igga netta tiwwura n ukeccuḍ n uzemmur. Akwadrun s řeḍruf ɣar uɣezdis n tewwart ittawi ijj n řexmus n řḥiḍ.

Tnayen n tewwura tuɣa atent zeg ukeccuḍ n uzemmur. Netta inqec daysen ineqqicen n ikiruben d tcejjura n tini d nnuwwarat yarezmen, uca iɣeǧef tiwwura s wureɣ. Uřa d ikiruben d tcejjura n tini ibezzeɛ i-ten s wureɣ.
Igga ɛawed řeḍruf i tnayen n iɣezdisen n wadaf n Wexxam n Zzawect Tameqqrant zeg ukeccuḍ n uzemmur, zeg ict n terbaɛt n řḥiḍ.

Tnayen n tewwura tuɣa atent zeg ukeccuḍ n tcejjart n umerzi. Tnayen n tɣemmura ɣar ṭṭarf n ict n tewwart tuɣa ttquwwarent di barra u tnayen n tɣemmura ttwaneqcent ɣar ṭṭarf n tenneɣnit tuɣa ttquwwarent di daxeř.
Netta inqec daysent ikiruben d tcejjura n tini d nnuwwarat yarezmen uca icellel i-tent s wureɣ, s ijj n wudem n teqcurt iřeɣɣen x wenqac.
Netta ibna řemraḥ ɣar daxeř s třata n iseddiyyen n tṣuḍar ittwassuydan u s yijj n useddi n tḥenya n tcejjart n tengelt.
Deg useggʷas wiss arebɛa ittwassars dsas n Taddart n SIDI, deg uyur Ziw.
Deg useggʷas wiss ḥiṭac n uyur Bul, aqa-t d ayur wiss tmenya, tᵉttwakemmeř Taddart s marra tiseqqar nnes u ɛlaḥsab marra lfarayiḍ nnes. Netta ibna i-tt deg ijj n řmijař n sebɛa n iseggʷusa.
